title: Fish fries, picnics and drinks
summary: Williams played many picnics, which sell beer and sandwiches, but not fish fries.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: Well, I know that's a musical family. Yeah. Clarence did, Jim. Did you go to many fish fries ever and hear those piano players and guitar players and stuff?
No, I never did food on these fish fries. Oh. No. I used to get plenty of fish fries once but I never did food on them.
I don't have much of them anymore. No. I don't think they used to. Do you play many picnics?
Oh, I play plenty of picnics.
I don't think I've got any picnics. It would be mostly like a dance.
It's a dance and you're selling and going on.
They sell all this stuff. Beer, pop, no whiskey, no wine, sandwich and so on. It's like they give up fat. They sell all that kind of stuff.
I guess they can't get too drunk on that beer.
No, it'll take plenty of beer to make you drunk.
I like drinking that whole wine. Whiskey. Whiskey.
Whiskey is the stuff that hits the spot.
